words.desc: Shimmering curtains of colored light seen in the night sky near the poles.
A large mass of snow and ice sliding suddenly down a mountainside.
A fast-growing giant grass with hollow woody stems, common in Asia.
A strip of sand or small stones along the edge of the sea.
A light, gentle movement of air.
A spiny desert plant with a thick fleshy stem that stores water.
A deep, narrow opening between steep rock walls, usually carved by a river.
A natural hollow space beneath the ground or inside a hillside.
A steep, high face of rock, often at the edge of the sea.
A visible mass of tiny water droplets or ice crystals floating high in the sky.
An icy body from outer space that grows a bright streaming tail near the sun.
A large underwater structure built over time by tiny marine animals in warm seas.
A common flower with a yellow center surrounded by white petals.
A very dry area of land that gets little rain and has few plants.
A long period with little or no rain that leaves land very dry.
A sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement of rock deep underground.
An event in which one body in space blocks the light of another, briefly darkening it.
A green flowerless plant with feathery fronds that spreads by spores.
An overflow of water that covers land which is normally dry.
The colorful part of a plant that blooms and later produces seeds.
A thick layer of tiny water droplets near the ground that makes it hard to see.
A large area of land covered thickly with trees and undergrowth.
A natural vent that regularly shoots boiling water and steam high into the air.
A huge, slow-moving mass of ice formed from packed snow over many years.
A common green plant with thin blades that covers lawns and fields.
Balls or lumps of ice that fall from storm clouds.
A naturally raised area of land with gentle slopes and a rounded top.
A huge tropical storm with very strong winds that forms over warm seas.
A large mass of frozen fresh water drifting in the sea after breaking off.
A piece of land completely surrounded by water.
A dense tropical area of tangled plant growth with hot and humid weather.
A large body of still water surrounded by land on all sides.
A flat green part of a plant that grows from a stem and makes food from sunlight.
A sudden bright flash of electricity in the sky during a storm.
A tall plant with large trumpet-shaped flowers that grows from a bulb.
A sacred aquatic plant with large round leaves and pink or white blossoms.
A broad-leaved tree famous for bright autumn colors and sweet sap.
An open area of land covered with grass and wild plants.
A streak of light made when a piece of space rock burns up in our atmosphere.
The natural rocky body that circles the Earth and shines at night.
A small soft green plant without flowers that grows in damp shady places.
A very tall natural rise of land with steep sides and a high peak.
Soft, sticky wet earth that forms after rain or flooding.
A fungus with a stalk and an umbrella-shaped cap that grows in damp places.
A large hardwood tree known for its strength and long life.
A huge body of salt water that covers most of the Earth's surface.
A flowering plant with elegant, oddly shaped blooms, often grown indoors.
A tall tropical plant with a bare trunk topped by a crown of huge fan-shaped leaves.
A small smooth stone worn round by water.
A tall cone-bearing tree that stays green all year and has thin needle-like leaves.
A large round body that travels around a sun on its own orbital path.
A small, shallow body of still water, often found in gardens or fields.
A small pool of water on the ground, usually left after rain.
Drops of water that fall from clouds in the sky.
An arch of colors that appears in the sky when sunlight shines through raindrops.
A large natural flow of fresh water moving across land toward the sea.
A hard solid lump of natural mineral material from the ground.
A fragrant flowering shrub with thorny stems and petals in many colors.
Tiny loose grains of crushed rock found on beaches and in deserts.
The hard protective covering left behind by a sea creature such as an oyster.
Soft white flakes of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather.
The loose top layer of earth in which plants grow.
A huge ball of glowing gas in space that looks like a point of light at night.
A small, narrow flow of fresh water running over land.
The huge glowing ball of hot gas that Earth travels around once a year.
A tall plant with a huge yellow bloom that turns to follow the light.
The moment each morning when the sun first appears above the horizon.
The time each evening when the sun goes down below the horizon.
A low, wet area of land overgrown with trees and covered with shallow water.
The loud rumbling or crashing noise that follows an electrical flash in the sky.
The regular rising and falling of the sea level caused by lunar gravity.
A violently spinning column of air reaching down from a storm cloud to the ground.
A tall woody plant with a single thick trunk, branches and leaves.
A series of enormous waves caused by a sudden shift of the seabed.
A spring flower with a cup-shaped bloom that grows from a bulb.
A long low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river.
An opening in the Earth's crust where molten rock, ash and gas burst out.
A place where flowing water drops steeply over a rocky edge.
A moving ridge of water that rises and rolls across the sea.
Air moving across the Earth's surface, sometimes gently and sometimes with great force.
